basic_info.description: Discover this rare & spacious two-bedroom + guest room/den, two-bathroom tri-level loft complete with deeded parking & storage. This home also includes exclusive roof rights, offering the opportunity to create a private roof deck with sweeping views of the San Francisco skyline. As you enter, you are immediately greeted by dramatic double-height ceilings and a sense of openness across the expansive living, dining, & kitchen areas. Just beyond the kitchen, a flexible bonus space serves as a breakfast nook or home office, complemented by a full bathroom & guest room/den.  The mezzanine level features a bedroom, full bathroom, walk-in closet, & convenient laundry room. On the penthouse level, you'll find a spacious second bedroom large enough to double as a home office. From here, two doors lead directly to your deeded rooftop area, where the prior roof deck was removed during the building's roof replacement, offering a new owner the rare ability to design & install a private deck of their own.  This home blends volume, flexibility, & the opportunity to create a one-of-a-kind outdoor oasis in the heart of the city.
